=== labels without colons and a load address
        org $c000
reset   sei
        cld
        ldx #$ff
        txs
loop    lda msg,x
        beq done
        jsr putc
        inx
        bne loop
done    jmp done
putc    sta $d012
        rts
msg     byte "HI",0
=== equates with equ and =
screen  equ $0400
colour  = $d800
width   equ 40
        org $1000
        lda #width
        sta screen
        sta colour+width-1
        ldx #<screen
        ldy #>screen
        rts
=== data directives
        org $2000
start   db 1,2,3
        byte $ff,%1010,'a'
        dw start,$1234
        word *
        ds 3
        blk 2,$55
        rts
=== zero page constants and absolute addresses
ptr     equ $fb
        org $0801
        lda ptr
        sta ptr+1
        lda (ptr),y
        ldx ptr,y
        lda $0400,x
        lda $d020
        jmp ($fffc)
        rts
=== branches and the location counter
        org $8000
top     bne *+4
        nop
        nop
        beq top
        bcc fwd
        nop
fwd     rts
        jmp *
=== instructions in every addressing mode
        org $0600
        lda #$12
        lda $12
        lda $12,x
        lda $1234
        lda $1234,x
        lda $1234,y
        lda ($12,x)
        lda ($12),y
        ldx $12,y
        stx $12,y
        asl a
        asl
        jmp ($1234)
        brk
